highlights: GAAP revenue decreased 1% and organic revenue was flat in the quarter;
GAAP EPS of $(11.17) and adjusted EPS of $1.75 in the quarter;
GAAP revenue for the company was $5.20 billion in the third quarter of 2026, a decrease of 1% compared to the third quarter of 2025.
GAAP revenue decreased 3% in the Merchant Solutions segment and was flat in the Financial Solutions segment in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the prior year period.
GAAP revenue for the company was $15.52 billion in the first nine months of 2026, a decrease of 2% compared to the first nine months of 2025.

quotes.text: Our team is executing with urgency, and we are seeing meaningful progress. Net attrition in banking is down more than 25 percent year to date, major client wins are now ramping, Clover continues to produce consistent underlying growth and our modern merchant platform is gaining momentum.
quotes.by: Takis Georgakopoulos, Chief Executive Officer of Fiserv

quotes.text: Our third quarter performance was in line with our expectations, including a return to organic revenue growth in Financial Solutions.
quotes.by: Paul Todd, Chief Financial Officer of Fiserv

outlook: Company expects to repurchase $500 million of shares in the fourth quarter of 2026
The company expects to repurchase $500 million of its common stock during the fourth quarter of 2026 under its existing share repurchase authorization.
Fiserv continues to expect organic revenue outlook of (1%) to 0% and adjusted earnings per share of $7.20 to $7.40 for 2026.
